reviews.comment: I would not take Dr. Boyd again. The grading is all exams and they are based on 1500+ bad lecture slides. The content is very easy, but it was abnormally difficult to know what to study for.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class has a lot of material with each lecture having fast, nonstop content for 50 minutes, 3 times a week, and you still get the feeling that Dr Boyd would go into more detail if he had the time. The class grade is four exams that can contain anything that Dr. Boyd has ever said. I think Dr Boyd teaches the material well, despite tough exams
reviews.ratingTags: Hilarious--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This was an online course with only exams and no homeworks. It was unclear what to study, we were just given the solutions for all the problems in the textbook. The class isn't that hard, but since you are on a time crunch on the exam, it was hard to answer all the questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: TAKE ANY OTHER PROFESSOR IF YOU CAN. But if you can't, get ready to teach yourself from the textbook. His lectures are super rapid power points with examples only from the textbook. He barely writes, just speaks the solution, then moves onto the next slide. Breakneck course pacing. No exam review. No help outside of class. yikes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: His method of teaching was very strange, he essentially would pull out textbook problems and half solve them over and over again throughout the entire year. This was ok for the exams as they were often very similar to textbook problems, but it made understanding the actual material very difficult. Get ready to learn the whole textbook yourself.

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyd used nearly incoherent presentations to teach, often requiring student to learn material entirely outside of class. Grading consisted of 4 tests, with minimal pre-test review or guidance. Dr. Boyd is a pleasant and fun person, but I would never recommend him as a teacher.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyd is an aerospace structures guy, so naturally this class is taught pretty well by him. The most challenging part of 304 is understanding the sign convention and boundary conventions, as he will remind you every lecture. The notes that he uses for the class are very digestible and you'll learn a lot in this quick summer class!
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy

reviews.comment: Condescending and rude.

Everyone complains about thermo regardless the professor so it really isn't the professor. Dr. Boyd is a hilarious guy who deadpans out of pocket comments. His teaching philosophy is simple, know the equations and when to use them, don't worry about plugging them in and numerical errors. Practicing homework is your responsibility so do it.
reviews.ratingTags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyd gets a bad wrap but you'll realize that he really is a great guy. Thermo is not the easiest class but he tries to make it fun with jokes and out of pocket examples. You have to do quite a bit of practice outside of lecture but he tells you what to study and quiz/exam questions basically come straight from the book. Go to office hours!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Inspirational

reviews.comment: He is by far the worst professor I've ever had, and I've had a lot of bad professors. He is rude and condescending and is super mean. He insulted my classmate and made her cry. He said we'd get an eq sheet for final and then told us we should know 50+ eq from the past 8 ch. This is a class where you have to learn on ur own. His true rating is 0.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Boyd is smart but I think his occasional condescension really discouraged question asking. You need to know how to apply even small concepts from chapters so study! Please watch yt videos (search engineering thermodynamics) and do textbook problems. Going to class will show you what concepts you need, but you're on your own. Good luck
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Worst prof I have ever taken, he doesn't care for students and it's as if he wants you to fail. There was a 54% Q-Drop percentage this semester and everyone despises him. You don't really learn anything from lectures and he is a super hard grader. You gotta learn outside of class for a slight chance of passing. Always in a bad mood and monotone.
reviews.ratingTags: Test heavy--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Boyd lives and breathes aerospace engineering, and his passion for the subject makes the (otherwise dry) subject material more interesting. Makes you work for it more than other professors. Time management is super important in this class bc theres no required hw so it's up to you to do tons of practice problems and be ready for the tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Inspirational

reviews.comment: Boyd was okay, but acted like he had never taught this class before even though records show that he had. I think he should've been more prepared all things considering. However, once you figure out how to study it's not so bad. Do textbook problems with your classmates.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyd is extremely dry. He knows his material, so moves relatively quickly through lectures (which are often just portions of the textbook). He does many practice problems during lectures that are similar to the test questions so pay attention to those. He will not finish any problems through completion though. No grades posted until EOY.

reviews.comment: Of all the options for thermodynamics, Boyd is probably the best. Lectures are pretty dry and mostly taken from the textbook, make sure to write down any tangents and do a lot of textbook problems to prepare for the quizzes and exams. The three exams make up about 70% of the grade, so good luck :)
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: His lecture slides are literally just pictures from the textbook. He doesn't actually explain anything, just tell you it's trivial. You are better off just not going to class.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Lectures are worthless, never gives any good examples or cares about the students. Acts as if everything is simple and never uploads lecture slides so be ready to watch lecture videos. Completely useless and required a second professor to make the class useful at the very least. DO NOT EMAIL!! gives no response or any useful information.

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyd is not a good professor. The lectures aren't very helpful and you have to essentially teach yourself. The quizzes are not very hard as they are over the homework however, the exams are unreasonably hard and unless you already know what you're doing, it is extremely difficult. Unlikely to get any curve and tough grader. Avoid if you can.

Dr. Boyd doesn't care about students. He can't spend 5 minutes uploading the slides, which he pretty much just copy pastes from the textbook anyways. He also spends a lot of time talking about how bad the textbook is. Quizzes and exams are rough, and his lectures were insufferable.

Very good at actually teaching material. The tests can be pretty difficult, but if you actually pay attention, try to learn, and do practice problems then you will get an A. Make sure you pay attention in class and sit close to the whiteboard where he writes everything. Dont be late or on your phone and for the love of God DONT ASK A DUMB QUESTION.

reviews.comment: Difficult class but he was always well prepared. Tests/quizzes were based on anything said in lecture plus a mass amount of practice problems. Slightly lenient in grading. Don't shy away from taking this professor even though you will have to put more work in. If anything, take Boyd for the experience, you won't forget him.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyd's lectures are very dry and tough to listen to. He is not the most approachable guy, but in the end, he teaches you what you need to know and if you take good notes and follow along with him, you will get a fine grade.

reviews.comment: Dr. Boyd is a funny professor that wants best for his students. His lectures are exactly the textbook chapters, but his notes are all done on a whiteboard.
